CustomField.description: Set to true when an application submitted by this guardian self-reports them as a Zeta employee (Employee Priority + the Primary/Secondary guardian picker). Drives pre-population of the Zeta-employee indicator on the guardian's subsequent applications. Self-reported and unverified — actual lottery priority is still gated by the "Parent is Zeta Staff" Priority Item review. Set-true-only; never auto-cleared.
CustomField.label: Self-Reported Zeta Employee
